newsitem.title: USA: A.M. Best reviews rate for insurance company.
newsitem.headline: A.M. Best reviews rate for insurance company.

text.p: A.M. Best Co said Monday it had placed the "A+" (Superior) rating of Home Beneficial Life Insurance Co, Richmond, Va., under review.
The company said it decided to put it under review after American General Corp signed a definitive agreement to acquire Home Beneficial Corp, the parent company, for $665 million, or $39 per share.

Home Beneficial Life Insurance Co writes ordinary life insurance, including universal life and term, as well as individual annuities in the home service market. A.M. Best Company is an insurance rating and information source.
The ratings of American General's subsidiaries were unaffected by the announcement, A.M. Best said.
